text_block_list.text:
While preparing for training
with El Condor Pasa...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A run before training
is the absolute best, yes!
choice_data_list: Aren't you running a bit too much?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all!
El hasn't even begun to run enough yet, deesu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, ¡vamos, Trainer!
Let's go train!

El Condor Pasa was always running around at full throttle,
so I instructed her on the importance of conserving energy.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I see. So it's not just about running recklessly, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for the advice!
I'll put it into practice with all my might, yeeees!!" his
I hope the message got through properly, though...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Goooal! 10 laps com☆plete!!
I can easily do 10 more laps, yes I can-desu!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Then wanna run just a little bit more?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...is what I'd like to say, desu,
but I will politely pass, desu."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hmm... It is because I thought that is what you would do, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El is certainly that great!
After all, El is growing day by day!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Learn, run, and grow strong!
That is who El Condor Pasa is, desu!
